description: This file defines the KinesisVideoArchivedMediaClient class, which extends AwsClient. It provides method signatures and documentation comments for interacting with the Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Archived Media service, including retrieving clips, streaming URLs, images, media fragments, and listing fragments.

classes.name: KinesisVideoArchivedMediaClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Archived Media service, providing methods for media retrieval and fragment listing.

methods.name: getClip
methods.description: Retrieves a media clip based on specified parameters.

methods.name: getDASHStreamingSessionURL
methods.description: Gets a DASH streaming session URL.

methods.name: getHLSStreamingSessionURL
methods.description: Gets an HLS streaming session URL.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves images associated with media fragments.

methods.name: getMediaForFragmentList
methods.description: Fetches media data for a list of fragments.
